title_en: Provisions on the Management of Compilation and Publication of Laws and Regulations

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Provisions are formulated for the purpose of strengthening the management of the compilation and publication of legal regulations, improving the quality of compilation and publication of legal regulations, and safeguarding the unity and dignity of the socialist legal system.

Article 2 For the purposes of these Provisions, "compilation of legal regulations" means a public publication that complies laws, administrative regulations, rules of the departments of the State Council (hereinafter referred to as departmental rules), local regulations, and local government rules promulgated in accordance with statutory procedures into a book in a certain order or classification.

Article 3 Unless otherwise provided by laws or administrative regulations, the compilation and publication of compilations of legal regulations (including selected compilations, classified compilations, complete collections, etc.) shall comply with these Provisions.
The compilation of legal regulations compiled and published in accordance with Article 4 of these Provisions shall be the official version of the state-published compilation of legal regulations.

Article 5 Where necessary for work, study, teaching, or research, relevant organs, organizations, enterprises, and institutions may compile and print compilations of legal regulations for internal use by themselves or by entrusting legal professionals; if such compilations need to be formally published, approval from the administrative department of publishing shall be obtained.
Except as provided in the preceding paragraph, individuals shall not compile compilations of legal regulations.

Article 6 In compiling a compilation of legal regulations, the following requirements shall be met:
(1) Accurate selection. The legal regulations included in the compilation must be accurate; if any abolished or ceased-to-be-effective regulation is included, such status must be noted; compilations of current regulations shall not include abolished or ceased-to-be-effective regulations.
(2) Complete content. The full text of the name, the approving or promulgating authority, the date of approval or promulgation, the date of coming into force, chapters, sections, articles, and other contents of the legal regulations included shall be fully compiled, and shall not be arbitrarily deleted or altered.
(3) Scientific arrangement. The compilation shall be arranged in a certain classification or order, which shall facilitate the development of various work.

Article 8 The national publication of compilations of laws in ethnic minority languages and foreign languages shall be organized or assisted in examination by the Legislative Affairs Commission of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.
The national publication of compilations of administrative regulations in ethnic minority languages and foreign languages shall be organized or assisted in examination by the Ministry of Justice.

Article 9 A publishing house that meets the requirements of Article 7 shall formulate a publication topic plan for compilations of legal regulations and submit it to the authority with the power to compile the legal regulations and to the administrative department of publishing for recordation respectively.

Article 10 A compilation of legal regulations compiled in accordance with Article 4 of these Provisions may have the national emblem printed on its cover; a compilation printed in accordance with the first paragraph of Article 5 of these Provisions shall not have the national emblem printed on its cover.
Article 11 In publishing a compilation of legal regulations, the printing quality must be guaranteed. The quality standards shall comply with the relevant provisions of the state.

Article 12 The distribution of compilations of legal regulations shall be the responsibility of Xinhua Bookstores, and Xinhua Bookstores in various localities shall diligently carry out subscription solicitation work.
Publishing houses that have the capability may also undertake part of the subscription solicitation work.

Article 14 If a party disagrees with the penalty decision made by the administrative department of publishing or the administrative department for industry and commerce, the party may, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the notice of penalty, apply for reconsideration to the administrative department of publishing or the administrative department for industry and commerce at the next higher level. If the party still disagrees with the reconsideration decision, the party may, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the notice of reconsideration decision, file a lawsuit with a People's Court. The party may also, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the notice of penalty, directly file a lawsuit with a People's Court. If the party neither applies for reconsideration nor files a lawsuit nor complies with the penalty decision within the time limit, the authority that made the penalty decision may apply to a People's Court for compulsory enforcement.
Article 15 Matters concerning the cooperative publication of compilations of legal regulations with overseas publishing institutions shall be handled by reference to these Provisions.
Article 16 The development and application of information technology processing of legal regulation documents shall be managed by reference to these Provisions.
Article 17 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
